newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Family Dollar downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Family Dollar downgraded.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said it removed Family Dollar Stores Inc from the firm's recommended list, lowering the rating to hold from buy, primarily due to the stock's price.

-- "The shares have become riskier and therefore have less margin for disappointments due to their greater valuation coupled with generally more difficult sales and earnings comparisons over the next four quarters," analysts Barry Rothberg and Geoffrey Engel said in a report.
